_why_only_two: Each mutant here was checked by hand to fail the assertion it TARGETS, not merely to
fail the test. Three earlier candidates -- looping to 0, looping to 1, and looping to
`$passes-1` -- were all reported caught, but every one of them died on
`pids[$i]: unbound variable` and tripped `assert r.returncode == 0` instead. A mutant
caught by a return code proves the verb crashes when broken; it proves nothing about
the property under test. ALL_CAUGHT is not evidence on its own -- read the failure.
